decision.reasoning_trace: I was looking for a high-quality portable Bluetooth speaker, but the product feed was significantly cluttered with non-speaker items such as carrying cases, protective covers, and charging cables (making up nearly 40% of the results). Among the actual speakers, the premium options like the Audio Pro C10 were a bit too expensive at over $400 for an impulsive online purchase, while the mid-range Sony SRS-XB43 is a solid contender but felt slightly outdated compared to current market standards. Several of the more affordable options like the DOSS Traveler had concerning reviews regarding long-term durability and volume loss after a few months. Given the mix of accessory clutter and mixed reviews on the mid-range hardware, I have decided to postpone my purchase and look for more current reviews on the Sony or wait for a sale on a more modern premium unit.
